newsitem.title: USA: OSB, FCB sharehodlers approve merger.
newsitem.headline: OSB, FCB sharehodlers approve merger.

text.p: Shareholders of OSB Financial Corp and FCB Financial Corp approved the merger of the two thrift holding companies in special meetings Thursday, the two companies said.

The transaction between the two holding companies is a merger of equals and the resulting company will operate under the name of FCB Financial Corp with corporate headquarters located in Oshkosh, the companies said. The merger will be effective May 1, they said.
Holders of OSB Financial common stock will receive 1.46 shares of FCB Financial common stock for each OSB Financial common share they own, the companies said.
